purpose: Teach: 通りすがり/引っかかっ/見逃す/警部/一目瞭然/閉ざさ/見抜く/難題

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 論文、通りすがりの研究者の意見、引用していますね。
lines.en: Your paper cites passing comments from researchers — you integrated those perspectives thoughtfully.
lines.style: Steady, observant gaze. Measured pace. Opening with warmth, not critique. Nodding slightly as she speaks, confirming rather than questioning.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論理の穴に、引っかかった部分、修正しました。
lines.en: Yes. I found places where the logic had gaps and worked through them carefully.
lines.style: Quiet intensity. Slight lean forward on 「穴に」. Not defensive — earnest accounting of effort. Voice steady and clear, finishing with gentle certainty.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 重要な視点、見逃すことなく、書きましたね。
lines.en: And you didn't overlook the crucial perspectives — they're clearly woven through.
lines.style: Affirming nod in the voice. Slower pace than before. Settling into genuine encouragement. Slight warmth at the edges, recognizing genuine work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 警部経験者へのインタビュー、章末で扱いました。
lines.en: I handled the ex-inspector interview at the end of that chapter — gave it proper weight there.
lines.style: Careful explanation. Slight uncertainty underneath — checking if this placement was the right choice. Not defensive, just wanting to be understood. Voice trails slightly on the reasoning.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 結論、一目瞭然の構成、評価できますね。
lines.en: The structure of your conclusion is genuinely transparent — you can see the thinking all the way through.
lines.style: Quiet approval. Slightly slower cadence. Recognitional — like she's seeing evidence of growth. Warm but not effusive, nodding as if confirming something she suspected.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 対立する文献も、閉ざさない姿勢、心がけました。
lines.en: I made a point of staying open to conflicting sources rather than closing them off.
lines.style: Humble but firm. Measured pace. Slight pride underneath, but held back. Voice steady, not apologetic. Finishing cleanly without trailing, as if declaring a choice he made.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 要点を見抜く力、よく出ていますね。
lines.en: The way you cut through to what matters — that really shows in the work.
lines.style: Direct recognition. Warm but unsentimental. Slight emphasis on 「見抜く」 — naming the actual skill. Lean back slightly, as if taking in the finished thing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 残された難題、次の研究に引き継ぎます。
lines.en: Whatever hard problems remain, I'll carry them forward into the next project.
lines.style: Quiet resolve. Respectful closing. Not rushed — gives each word weight. Voice steady and reflective, looking forward without hesitation. Slight formal undertone, honoring the work ahead.
